classification: Definition and Empirical Criterion; no proof or native observation

schema_rules.purpose: Type descriptions below are the complete normative field sets, not an executable JSON Schema. Reject unknown/missing/duplicate fields at every level.
schema_rules.integer: unsigned decimal in range, no negative zero/leading zero/fraction/exponent; booleans are not integers
schema_rules.canonicalization: ascii-json-1086/1 as specified in prose; recursive lexicographic object keys; arrays ordered; no BOM or whitespace; unique keys; strings ASCII; slash unescaped; controls lowercase \u00xx; quote/backslash escaped
schema_rules.binding_fields: accepted_binding and tied_aliases objects contain exactly the keys and values supplied in this contract
schema_rules.provenance: source paths are metadata only; inference never resolves external components
schema_rules.hash_cycle: contract file has no self digest; manifest binds final contract digest; artifact whole digest is external; native_state excludes manifest and all declared hashes

manifest.name: literal R4LearnedReferenceV1
manifest.identity_index: u32 less than 120; agrees with both original frame JSONs

export_provenance.exporter_sources: source_file array sorted by path, nonempty

native_receipt.result_sha256: hex64 of ascii-json-1086/1 canonical nested model or refusal result
native_receipt.logical_forwards: u32, 1 for MODEL_TOKEN, 0 for adapter refusal

capability.qualification_receipt_sha256: hex64 or null; null iff NOT_RUN

identities.component_sha256: SHA256 exact bytes; each emitted manifest component adds only sha256 to its fixed descriptor
identities.native_state: L(domain),u32le component count; each component: L(name),L(kind),L(dtype),u32le rank,u64le dimensions,u64le bytes,exact payload; then u32le identity_index,L(operator_profile)
identities.L: u32le byte count then ASCII bytes
identities.historical_state: For each original unprefixed name sorted lexicographically, compact sorted JSON {name,shape,dtype:torch.float32}, LF, contiguous little-endian f32 bytes; exclude core.lm_head.weight; no additional domain/count prefix
identities.source_file_cids: verified by exporter on original files; loader matches trusted provenance and independently verifies decoded states
identities.frame_tree: historical frame-tree recipe and prefix witnesses from pinned frames.py; original JSON and decoded table agreement required

loader.layout_stage: INVALID_COMPONENT covers count/name/kind/order/offset/bytes/hash; INVALID_TENSOR covers parameter dtype/shape/finite and tied alias. Frame table dtype/shape/ranges/finite/agreement is INVALID_FRAME_TABLE; original JSON decode/mappings is INVALID_CODEC_POLICY for vocabulary/policy and INVALID_FRAME_TABLE for frame JSON. Declared length checked before dtype-dependent product.
loader.offset_units: For byte/layout errors offset is payload-relative byte offset (container structural errors container-relative); for tensor/frame numeric errors offset is flattened component element index; otherwise null. Component null when not applicable.
loader.whole_identity: expected whole hash is trusted input, not manifest self identity
loader.gate_mutations: One immutable independent mutation per validation tag. Fixture-only ExpectedBinding may recompute expected whole SHA and prior-stage component digests solely to reach target stage; accepted source/state/codec/frame constraints remain fixed. Freeze bytes and expected tag before invoking loader; count all copies in byte ledger. These synthetic bindings never qualify real exports or hosts. Wrong expected hash uses unmodified artifact. Missing qualification is tested separately with valid export.
loader.trusted_field_equalities: manifest.contract_sha256 equals ExpectedBinding.contract_sha256; manifest.export_provenance.release_sha256 equals ExpectedBinding.export_release_sha256; manifest.source_binding equals ExpectedBinding.accepted_binding. Any mismatch is SOURCE_BINDING_MISMATCH. manifest.operator_profile equals ExpectedBinding.operator_profile and supported profile, otherwise UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE. These checks precede component validation.
loader.gate_attempt_accounting: Exactly 12 loader calls maximum: 11 rejected mutations (one per validation tag, including wrong expected artifact SHA) plus one successful valid export load used for the missing-qualification probe and accepted decoded-state checks. No separate duplicate wrong-hash case. Gate success loads at most two model states (reader and core); each of 11 rejected attempts may partially validate up to two model states (22 partial model-state validations maximum); report every wire/tensor component and stage reached. Reuse the successful gate engine for all zero-forward checks, then unload before scoring. Count all work in export/integrity phase; no forwards. Four later scoring/replay engines/eight model-state loads are separate.

api.request: Exact original raw-byte request schema and refusal contract in policy.json and #1085; Rust &[u8] or owned bytes; no transport encoding chosen
api.response: Original MODEL_TOKEN object or original adapter refusal, unchanged; optional native_receipt separately pairs with result; native error is separate Result error with no model token
api.capability_admission: Trusted qualification_binding must match active ExpectedBinding, native binary/runtime and accepted review; a supplied self assertion is insufficient. Without it only separately admitted harness access is possible.
api.parameter_state: immutable; one request replaces four facts; scratch and audit reset; no semantic persistence
api.loader_limit_allocation: Check all lengths/products/conversions before allocation; exact fixed component count and bytes; malformed bytes never produce partial engine

operator_profile.build: release, generic target CPU, scalar code; exact rustc/lockfile/flags/binary bound in later release
operator_profile.rounding: round-to-nearest ties-to-even; preserve subnormals, no FTZ/DAZ
operator_profile.reductions: ascending contracted indices; positive zero start; round each product/add separately to f32 or f64; bias after completed dot; no FMA, reassociation, fast math or gauge cancellation
operator_profile.softmax: subtract finite max; libm::expf on f32 difference; f32 ascending sum then f32 division; padding exact positive zero
operator_profile.layer_norm: two-pass f32 last-axis mean/biased variance; libm::sqrtf(variance+epsilon); divide; affine only final 64-vector, multiply then add
operator_profile.r4: exact original f64 matrices; encode source transpose, transport destination transpose times source, weight/pool, decode destination, then round32; continuous all-valid-token frame fold across five clauses
operator_profile.binding_dot: f64 product/add by block 0..15 then lane 0..3; completed sum round32 before f32 division by eight and f32 softmax
operator_profile.argmax: full 4096 head / valid role tokens; minimum index exact finite tie
operator_profile.nonfinite: Only masked padding negative infinity permitted; all other nonfinite intermediates/outputs cause NUMERICAL_FAILURE
operator_profile.source_equations: docs/r4_native_reference_1086_operator_audit.md; exact operator closure in companion operator_sources.json

comparison.classification: New empirical engineering comparison on reused known authoring fixtures; preservation is unverified
comparison.fixture_source: Original #1094 authoring files and independent references in their frozen file order; later release binds actual file digests and owner before load; no withheld
arms: pinned Python two-stage R4 execution=r4 control=none

numeric_criterion.report: all maxima/locations and reference errors; unused query-location soft role included

comparison.replay: exact within implementation results/tensor bytes/state/diagnostics/work; cross-runtime only frozen comparison criterion
comparison.persistence: all compared tensor bytes for both arms in both phases, results, immutable receipts, complete bounded failure evidence
comparison.reference_failure: Nonfinite/reference error, required reference floor failure or reference fresh-replay failure => UNAVAILABLE_NATIVE_REFERENCE, retain reference errors, no native verdict
comparison.candidate_failure: Valid reproducing reference plus candidate-side numeric/discrete/refusal/replay failure => NATIVE_REFERENCE_MISMATCH; zero-forward loader-gate mismatch also records candidate engineering failure, no numerical verdict

budgets.scope: Count original authoring files once, both exports, all mutation copies, temp/writes/results; external monotonic supervisor includes startup/identity/final writes/exit; stop overrides completion; one consumed envelope; no retries, deletion to hide overruns, tuning or resets

terminal_actions.NATIVE_REFERENCE_PRESERVED: Independent review/deliver bounded native reference then hand exact artifact/operation to #1084; no final-kernel or #954 qualification
terminal_actions.NATIVE_REFERENCE_MISMATCH: Preserve failed candidate evidence and Python qualification; no promotion; separate scoped repair and new reviewed envelope
terminal_actions.UNAVAILABLE_NATIVE_REFERENCE: Preserve admission/reference failure; no model verdict; dependent work NOT_RUN
terminal_actions.ABORTED_NATIVE_REFERENCE_BUDGET: Preserve all partial evidence and stop; no renewed allowance
